sentences.text: Jared Tristan Padalecki -LRB- born July 19 , 1982 -RRB- is an American actor .
He is best known for his role as Sam Winchester on Supernatural .	Sam Winchester	Sam Winchester	Supernatural	Supernatural (U.S. TV series)
